_comment: Copy to data/score-overrides.json. The pipeline reads this file at scoring time. Three categories: boost (companies you want to see ranked higher), penalize (companies you want to see ranked lower or excluded — score: null means hard penalize at floor), block (companies you never want to see).
_documentation: Auto-populated entries come from scripts/sync-score-feedback.mjs reading data/applications.md (Applied/Evaluated → boost; Rejected → penalize). Manual entries should set source: 'manual' so the sync script knows not to overwrite them.

example-good-company.reason: Recruiter call confirmed comp range above floor + remote-friendly. Strong cultural fit indicators in JD.

example-block.reason: Don't show me roles from this company under any circumstances (e.g. previous bad experience, ethics conflict, founder reputation issue).
